project: Belirsizlik Altında Cevap Vermekten Kaçınan Yapay Zekâ
purpose: First-wave technical triage of previously unopened BugsInPy candidate cases; this manifest is not a confirmatory registry.
case_acceptance: none; every case must pass separate manual review and the strict registry gates

workflow_behavior.trigger: push to research branch only when this manifest changes, or workflow_dispatch
workflow_behavior.test_execution: Run the focused target test command on each BugsInPy synthetic buggy/fixed working tree; for the cookiecutter tox case run only py36 to avoid unrelated unavailable py37/py38/pypy envs.
workflow_behavior.fixed_tree_semantics: Upstream BugsInPy assembles the fixed working tree by applying changed files from the fixed commit on top of the buggy base; HEAD may remain the buggy commit. Preserve fixed-tree diff hashes/stats rather than requiring HEAD to equal fixed_commit_id.
workflow_behavior.automated_output: Raw exit codes/signatures/logs and SHA256Sums for human review only
workflow_behavior.last_code_fix: Black candidate requires editable installation of the checked-out worktree to generate the local _black_version.py module imported by tests; the validation workflow now performs this only for black-2. Cookiecutter-1 was removed from the matrix because its buggy-side failure was a missing non_ascii.json fixture (FileNotFoundError), while the fixed-side pass depended on that fixture being present; this did not isolate the intended encoding behavior and it is not valid reproduction evidence.

notes: Run 39636098825 did not validate any target test for completed cases: missing BugsInPy CLI PATH caused checkout exit 127. This run is classified as workflow setup failure, not a bug reproduction result.

All eight cases in this technical validation manifest are used only to debug/validate the workflow and inspect raw target-test signals; they are permanently excluded from confirmatory analysis. Do not re-add them to the manual screening queue or case registry.

Cookiecutter-1 is not run in the next workflow attempt: the prior raw log showed FileNotFoundError for tests/test-generate-context/non_ascii.json on buggy and pass on fixed, so it cannot be counted as an intended bug reproduction. The case remains permanently excluded from confirmatory analysis.
